_instructions.purpose: Use this template to create a new Longer Ride entry for rides.json
howToUse: 2. Paste it into the 'longerRides' array in rides.json
3. Fill in all the fields following the guidance below
4. Remove any fields marked as OPTIONAL if not needed
5. Save rides.json and rebuild the site

fieldGuide.id: Lowercase, hyphenated: {title-slug}-{YYYY-MM-DD} e.g. 'lock-stock-and-barrel-2026-02-21' or 'city-slickers-2026-tbd' for TBD dates
fieldGuide.title: The ride name as it appears in the accordion header
fieldGuide.date: ISO format YYYY-MM-DD e.g. '2026-02-21', or null for TBD rides
fieldGuide.year: Four digit year as a number (not string), e.g. 2026
fieldGuide.distanceMiles: Total distance as a number (not string), e.g. 27
fieldGuide.overallTime: Estimated duration e.g. '3.5 hours' or '7-8 hours'
fieldGuide.meetPoint.name: Meeting location name
fieldGuide.meetPoint.googleMapsUrl: Google Maps link to meeting point
fieldGuide.meetPoint.note: OPTIONAL - Extra info like 'NOTE EARLIER START'
fieldGuide.notes: Array of strings - each string is a separate line. Empty array [] for upcoming rides

_instructions.sortingNote: Longer Rides are sorted: dated rides first (chronologically), then TBD rides at the end

newRide.title: Ride Title Here
newRide.guidance: Brief description of the route and any tips for riders.
